oneLiner: It turns a child's dream into a learning path from real lessons it finds online, read aloud at the child's level.

problem.person: Imma, a Brussels teacher with 20 to 30 pupils aged 12 to 18 per class.
problem.text: Levels and motivation differ widely, and vetting extra material costs her evenings.

stake.text: From the challenge briefing: one teacher, very different skill and motivation levels.

built.text: An agent that finds free lessons online and builds a tutor at the child's level.

how.title: How it works
how.headline: The child names a dream; the agent browses; the tutor teaches aloud and remembers.

demo.text: Watch a child ask once and the agent build a personal tutor live.
demo.fallback: If the agent is slow tonight, this is the tutor it built earlier today.

next.works: Seven-question request, web research by H, lessons with sources, read-aloud.
next.missing: Content screening with reasons, class paths per level, SmartSchool link.
next.then: Soft-skill modules, a library for courses by teachers, a Brussels pilot, a native app.

close.line: Whether or not the dream comes true, the skills do.
